paths.title: Suspicious path join is constrained by two controls
paths.asset: Files outside the public download directory
paths.precondition: The attacker supplies a path that survives validation.
steps: The basename check rejects separators and the allowlist rejects every other name.
mitigations: Keep both canonical-name validation and the allowlist.
paths.analysis: The sink is dangerous in isolation, but no attacker-controlled path reaches it.
paths.defense: Basename equality plus PUBLIC_FILES allowlist; removing either control would be fragile.
paths.remediation: Retain both checks and add traversal regression tests.
paths.validation: Reject ../guide.txt, nested/guide.txt, and an unlisted basename.
